cond_0001.intro: Designs, develops, and coordinates the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Reviews project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problem, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Drafts detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal or shops for test fixtures.
Devises, fabricates, assembles and tests new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyzes indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modifies or adjusts product/equipment to meet specifications.
Records test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develops models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulates model with Agilent ADS or SPICE.
Ensures the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Feedback learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Experience programming with MATLAB and Spice, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and groups of employees.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Reviews project instructions and blueprints to determine test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problems, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Drafts detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Devises, fabricates, assembles, and tests new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyzes indicated and calculated test results against design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modifies or adjusts product/equipment to meet specifications.
Records test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develops models with electromagnetic field solvers: primarily Ansys HFSS and CST Microwave Studio; secondarily Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulates models with Agilent ADS or SPICE and ensures the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Performs and develops VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Uses design tools including Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Coordinates with package, PCB, and silicon designers on measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Feeds findings from measurement-simulation correlation work back into modeling and simulation best practices.
Applies transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0016.requirements:
Completion of a bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, and Mil/Aero Specifications.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting of complex technical concepts.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to document findings and share information clearly with managers, clients, customers, and other employees as required.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Review project instructions and blueprints to determine test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, the nature of technical problems, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to direct parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Devise, fabricate, assemble, and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results against design or rated specifications and test objectives, and determine modifications or adjustments needed to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave Studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Execute simulations using Agilent ADS or SPICE. Ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Lead VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Drive measurement-simulation correlation projects in collaboration with package, PCB, and silicon designers.
Apply learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0062.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
3–12 Years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and employees.

cond_0078.intro: We are looking for a Senior Signal Integrity Engineer to join our team. The role involves designing, developing, and coordinating the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion.
cond_0078.responsibilities:
Review project instructions and blueprints to clarify test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, and the nature of technical problems, and actively discuss possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Devise, fabricate, assemble, and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modify or adjust product/equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: primarily Ansys HFSS and CST Microwave Studio; secondarily Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE and ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Regularly collaborate and communicate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects, and bring people together to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
Share and discuss learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0078.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical, or vocational school.
3–12 Years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to colleagues, managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations, and write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

cond_0220.intro: We are looking for a Senior Signal Integrity Engineer to join our team. This role involves designing, developing, and coordinating the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion. People who do well here tend to get up to speed quickly on electromagnetic and signal integrity concepts.
cond_0220.responsibilities:
Review project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problem, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal or shops for test fixtures.
Devise, fabricate, assemble and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modify or adjust product/equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE.
Ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Feed back learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0220.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and groups of employees.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

cond_0258.intro: We are looking for a Senior Signal Integrity Engineer to join our team. The role involves designing, developing, and coordinating the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion.
cond_0258.responsibilities:
Review project instructions and blueprints to clarify test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, and the nature of technical problems, and actively discuss possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Devise, fabricate, assemble, and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modify or adjust product/equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: primarily Ansys HFSS and CST Microwave Studio; secondarily Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE and ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Regularly collaborate and communicate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects, and bring people together to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
Share and discuss learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical, or vocational school.
3–12 Years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to colleagues, managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations, and write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

cond_0297.intro: We are looking for a Senior Signal Integrity Engineer to join our team.
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Coordinate the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion.
Work with project instructions and blueprints together with the team to clarify test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, and technical problems, and help identify solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Fabricate, assemble, and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products, or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control, working alongside relevant team members.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and coordinate adjustments to products or equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and share recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave Studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE, and help ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Develop and apply VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Share learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to help improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and employees.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

cond_0387.intro: We are looking for a Senior Signal Integrity Engineer to join our team.
cond_0387.responsibilities:
Coordinate the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion.
Work with project instructions and blueprints together with the team to clarify test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, and technical problems, and help identify solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Fabricate, assemble, and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products, or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control, working alongside relevant team members.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and coordinate adjustments to products or equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and share recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave Studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE, and help ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Develop and apply VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Share learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to help improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and employees.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

cond_0471.intro: Designs, develops, and coordinates the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion by performing the following duties.
cond_0471.responsibilities:
Other duties may be assigned.
Reviews project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problem, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Drafts detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal or shops for test fixtures.
Devises, fabricates, assembles and tests new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyzes indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modifies or adjusts product/equipment to meet specifications.
Records test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develops models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulates model with Agilent ADS or SPICE.
Ensures the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Feedback learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.

Working knowledge of design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Some experience programming with MATLAB and Spice, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Comfort reading, analyzing, and interpreting business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations; ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Willingness to present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and groups of employees.
Exposure to applying mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.

Review project instructions and blueprints with the team to clarify test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, the nature of technical problems, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal, or shops for test fixtures.
Devise, fabricate, assemble, and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modify or adjust product/equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: primarily Ansys HFSS and CST Microwave Studio; secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE and ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Actively collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers on a regular basis to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects, communicating findings clearly and raising issues early.
Share learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations with the team to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models; and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0537.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA, and skew/jitter measurements.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations; ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Comfortable presenting information and responding to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and employees.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to tasks such as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

cond_0554.intro: Designs, develops, and coordinates the design and production of high-speed multigigabit connectors, test boards, and laboratory testing from inception to completion. Most people become stronger in this work over time as they build experience with simulation, measurement, and modeling techniques.
cond_0554.responsibilities:
Reviews project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problem, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies. Drafts detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal or shops for test fixtures. Devises, fabricates, assembles and tests new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control. Analyzes indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modifies or adjusts product/equipment to meet specifications. Records test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method. Develops models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave. Simulates model with Agilent ADS or SPICE. Ensures the accuracy of models used for simulation. Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations. Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD. Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects. Feedback learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation. Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
Other duties may be assigned.
cond_0554.requirements:
Completion of a bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years related experience or training, and / or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience programming with MATLAB and Spice, and hands on experience of Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA and skew/jitter measurements.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil / Aero Specifications.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and groups of employees.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

People who do well here tend to get up to speed quickly on electromagnetic and signal integrity concepts.
cond_0562.responsibilities:
Review project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problem, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Draft detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal or shops for test fixtures.
Devise, fabricate, assemble and test new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyze indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modify or adjust product/equipment to meet specifications.
Record test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develop models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulate models with Agilent ADS or SPICE.
Ensure the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Feed back learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0562.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience programming with MATLAB and SPICE, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and groups of employees.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Reviews project instructions and blueprints to ascertain test specifications, procedures, objectives, test equipment, nature of technical problem, and possible solutions such as part redesign, substitution of material or parts, or rearrangement of parts or subassemblies.
Drafts detail drawings or sketches to request parts fabrication by machine, PCB, sheet metal or shops for test fixtures.
Devises, fabricates, assembles and tests new or modified mechanical components or assemblies for products or to obtain data for development, standardization, and quality control.
Analyzes indicated and calculated test results in relation to design or rated specifications and test objectives, and modifies or adjusts product/equipment to meet specifications.
Records test procedures and results, numerical and graphical data, and recommendations for changes in product or test method.
Develops models with electromagnetic field solvers: Primarily Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave studio. Secondarily, Ansys Q3D and SIwave.
Simulates model with Agilent ADS or SPICE.
Ensures the accuracy of models used for simulation.
Perform and develop VNA/TDR measurement techniques to validate models and simulations.
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Collaborate with package, PCB, and silicon designers to complete measurement-simulation correlation projects.
Feedback learning from measurement-simulation correlation investigations to improve best practices for modeling and simulation.
Understand and apply transmission-line and electromagnetic-field theory; VNA/TDR measurements; statistical simulators for serial data (SerDes) links; dual-Dirac and other jitter models and insertion loss, return loss, cross talk, BER, jitter, and statistical eye diagrams.
cond_0631.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or physics from a four-year college or university, technical or vocational school.
Three to twelve years of related experience or training, and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Knowledge in power, microwave, numerical field solver, and electromagnetic transmission theories.
Experience programming with MATLAB and Spice, and hands-on experience with Time Domain Reflectometers (TDR), VNA and skew/jitter measurements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills that demonstrate the ability to express complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to use design tools such as Ansys HFSS, Altium Designer, PLTS, Visual Studio, MPLAB, Atmel Studio, CREO, SolidWorks, SpaceClaim, and AutoCAD.
Experience with PCIe, Fiber Channel, InfiniBand, Ethernet, Mil/Aero Specifications.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and groups of employees.
Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
